data.body_html:
Marbella's Feria San Bernabe 2029 is set to be the summer's biggest party, and there's no better way to experience it than from the deck of a luxury yacht. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet offers front-row seats to the fair's nightly fireworks, with all drinks, snacks, and a skipper included. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or an 8-hour floating fiesta, we have the boat for you. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, up to €4,719 for 4 hours on a Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski. Read on for everything you need to plan your perfect Feria San Bernabe 2029 yacht charter.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Feria San Bernabe 2029?

The Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's most iconic fair, held annually in early June. The fairgrounds buzz with rides, music, and traditional casetas, but the highlight is the spectacular fireworks display over the Mediterranean. Instead of battling crowds on the beach, charter a private yacht from Puerto Banús. You'll anchor just offshore, with unobstructed views, your own bar, and space to dance or relax. It's the ultimate VIP experience, perfect for groups of friends, families, or couples. Plus, you can combine it with a coastal cruise to see Marbella's coastline from the water.

Our Fleet for Feria San Bernabe 2029

We offer a wide range of boats to suit every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the fairgrounds. Here are the top picks for a boat party:

What's Included in Your Charter

Every booking comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. For the Mangusta 80 (white or grey), a jet ski is included free for 4-hour bookings. You can bring your own food or order catering via WhatsApp. The skipper will anchor near the fair fireworks display and can also take you to nearby coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

Best Boats for a Fireworks Viewing Party

For the best fireworks experience, choose a boat with an open deck or flybridge. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a spacious upper deck perfect for panoramic views. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) has a large sunpad and aft deck for lounging. If you're on a budget, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is agile and easy to anchor close to the action. For a superyacht experience, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) provides ultimate luxury with multiple decks.

How to Book Your Feria San Bernabe Yacht Charter

Booking is simple. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly via our website at fixed rates. For all other yachts, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, and Ferretti 94, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks in advance, as the fair week is extremely popular. Contact us now to check availability for your preferred date.

Feria San Bernabe 2029: Dates and Tips

The fair typically runs for 10 days in early June (exact dates for 2029 will be confirmed by Marbella council in late 2028). The fireworks are usually held on the final Saturday night. Arrive at Puerto Banús by 7 PM to enjoy a sunset cruise before anchoring near the fairgrounds. Bring a light jacket – the sea breeze can cool down after sunset. Don't forget your camera for the fireworks over the water.
